original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: List the existing independent checks for the exact selected or candidate sources. Pick a new changed input, missing binding or distinct failure mode; stop with a handoff if the proposed arithmetic check is already covered.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Independently recount PR2586, PR2662 and PR2712 transport profiles and certify the changed local moment budget against one additional uncompensated H1, at the selected primitive saving and a planning benchmark.
scope_change_reason: The original card asks for a specific missing source-bound implication in a changed supplier. PR2662 and PR2712 prove local concavity improvements but do not quantify their allowance for extra charged children; PR2713 already covers their endpoint-run rank implication.
bottleneck_link: A source-bound allowance below one uncompensated H1 limits which hosting/retention completions can preserve the local gain and supplies a concrete full-cost stop test.
stop_rule: Stop after three source-bound profile recounts, two exact cost/threshold certificates, semantic controls, registered normal/optimized replay and a focused PR. Do not expand the P104 family or claim a complete supplier.
evidence: RESULT.json; three literal word censuses; exact rational log/Taylor enclosures; two gain=1 brackets of width 1e-12; six mathematical controls and six artifact/oracle test groups.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance in derivation, implementation, writing and internal review. No independent human or proof-assistant review claimed.

open_questions.question: For an explicit consumer outside the concurrent five-forward/four-dual screen, can one actual owner window realize either changed word below the certified net allowance?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Local moment savings do not prove a complete favorable hosted bill.
open_questions.first_step: Pin an actual caller and price old/new rank-3 through rank-7 children, decreasing endpoints and every idle/return credit.
open_questions.blocked_by: No complete physical caller/window or invoice is supplied by this audit.

open_questions.question: Can a concrete two-call contract amortize one added child while retaining its local saving?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One H1 shared across two calls is less than their combined savings, so the per-call obstruction does not exclude sharing.
open_questions.first_step: Write and independently check a two-call dirty-state identity, then price retention, restoration and every changed child.
open_questions.blocked_by: No shared-endpoint construction or fully charged consumer is supplied.

family_expansion_decision: Finish audit; narrow next work to one fully charged owner window. No dependent optimization campaign inferred.

freshness.limits: Open PR titles/bodies including drafts and Discussion bodies/comments/replies were completely paginated at the recorded times; local top-level package notes and ledger were also searched. No arbitrary diffs or closed remote PRs are covered. This does not prove novelty.
freshness.compatibility: Main advanced after the scientific baseline. AGENTS, autoresearch, CONTRIBUTING, catalogue, family status, package runner and both live selected inputs are unchanged; source heads #2662 and #2712 are unchanged. Original source pins remain fixed.

verification_environment.static_diagnostics: ruff check --select E4,E7,E9,F,B,UP,I --target-version py312 on both new Python files; passed

verification_environment.internal_review: Separate read-only mathematical/source review and 90-digit Decimal corroboration; monotonicity proof added. Not independent human review.
